thread_text:
Maya Patel: FYI recruiter ops reported missing scorecards on a few panels this AM after the nightly ATS sync. Panels 8124, 8125. Anyone seeing failures?
Samir Khan: I noticed webhook 502s around 03:12 and a schema error in the importer.
RecruitBot: alert: ats-sync failure request_id=req_b12f retry=2 status=502
Evan Li: Importer log: 
ERROR: deserialize_scorecard: unexpected_field 'legacy_checkbox'
payload sample: {"panel_id":8124,"scorecard":{"sections":[...],"legacy_checkbox":true}}
Julie Chen: We rolled a tiny scorecard change last night to remove that checkbox. ATS still sends it for old panels.
Maya Patel: Okay. Quick plan? We need interviews to have scorecards before afternoon slots.
Samir Khan: I'll push a hotfix to make the deserializer ignore unknown fields and add a migration job to strip legacy_checkbox. Canary ETA 20m.
Julie Chen: Please also add a short note to the interviewer guide saying checkbox deprecated and won't affect scoring. I'll notify recruiting ops.
Evan Li: After canary looks good I'll run a targeted backfill for panels 8124/8125:
./tools/ats-import --panel 8124 --reconcile
Maya Patel: Great. Can @RecruitBot open a ticket for the postmortem and owner assignment?
RecruitBot: created ticket R-2026-412: "ATS importer: legacy scorecard field causing import failures" assigned to Samir Khan due 2026-06-10
Samir Khan: Taking ownership. Will update when backfill completes.
